subject: Obviate calculation of chi-square in WLS measurement model

messages.author: 62219a92fbcbdd15
messages.subject: Obviate calculation of chi-square in WLS measurement model
parts:
Hi everyone, 

Is there an argument to suppress the estimation of chi-square? I'm iteratively fitting a large model using WLS, which takes several hours to estimate. MPlus offers the ability to remove the chi-square calculation using the NOCHISQUARE option, but I can't seem to find an equivalent in lavaan.

Christopher Gallagher

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Obviate calculation of chi-square in WLS measurement model
parts: Is there an argument to suppress the estimation of chi-square?

You can set test = "none" (see the ?lavOptions help page for a description).  You could also set se = "none" if you want to suppress SEs (and thus Wald tests) for individual parameters.
